_doc: Non-crypto fixtures the in-process differential oracle cannot execute for a STRUCTURAL reason (not a missing crypto witness). Post-mortem remediation #1 added a real deploy->call->Spend path (conformance/witnesses/real-crypto/ via runar-testing runStatefulSpend) and MOVED every stateful fixture whose continuation could be driven and re-validated on @bsv/sdk Spend with a real checkPreimage binding out of this list. What REMAINS: (1) GO-ONLY — compilers:[go]; the TypeScript tier ships no Stack-IR codegen (compile() cannot emit bytes). (2) INTERPRETER-UNSUPPORTED — the ANF interpreter does not model the raw-script intrinsic. (3) STATEFUL-HARNESS-GAP — a StatefulSmartContract whose continuation the SDK call() path could NOT build into a Spend-valid tx in this harness (multi-output raw-output funding, branched var-length state OP_NUM2BIN, or output/prevout-introspection that needs a specific tx shape the SDK does not emit). These stay covered by the Go tx-context path (conformance/script_execution_test.go executeScriptWithTx) and are honest FOLLOW-UPS, not silent caps. See conformance/witnesses/README.md.

inapplicable.reason: UnsafeSmartContract asm({body:'51'}) raw-script intrinsic is not implemented by the ANF interpreter (source-semantics engine reports 'Unknown function: asm'); the compiled OP_1 is anyone-can-spend with no rejecting witness
BabyBear field proof-system primitive is Go-only (compilers:[go]); no TypeScript Stack-IR codegen, compile() cannot emit deployed bytes
BabyBear quartic-extension proof-system primitive is Go-only (compilers:[go]); no TypeScript codegen

sendToScript(): a TWO-output method — addRawOutput(1000, scriptBytes) plus the addOutput(0, count) state continuation. The SDK call() path funds a single continuation output; it does not fund/emit the separate 1000-sat raw output, so the real Spend rejects (checkPreimage output binding fails). FOLLOW-UP: build the raw output via CallOptions.outputs. Covered by the Go tx-context path

spend(): branched mutation of count + a fixed-width ByteString state field re-encodes state via OP_NUM2BIN. Driven through the SDK call() path the recomputed continuation width does not match (OP_NUM2BIN 'size not large enough') — the harness cannot reconstruct the exact branched serialisation. FOLLOW-UP: port the Go witness construction. Covered by the Go tx-context path

payBond(): requireOutputP2PKH(0, bondPKH, bondAmount) demands output 0 be a specific P2PKH, but the SDK continuation places the STATE output at index 0 — the harness cannot compose the required output layout. FOLLOW-UP: use CallOptions.outputs to place the bond output. Covered by the Go tx-context path

bind(): extractPrevOutputScript(0, expectedHash) asserts the input's prevout script hashes to a constructor-baked expectedHash — a value only known after the deploy locking script exists (circular for a synthetic harness). FOLLOW-UP: deploy, read back the real prevout script, then re-deploy with its hash. Covered by the Go tx-context path
